About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.
•	Prepare, measure, cut, shape and align metal sections using hand tools, grinders, flame-cutting equipment and fabrication machinery.
•	Perform MIG, TIG and arc welding to manufacture, assemble, repair and modify trailers, heavy transport equipment and structural steel components.
•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Qualifications:

•	Trade qualification as a Welder (First Class), Engineering Tradesperson (Fabrication), or equivalent recognised qualification.
•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and technical specifications.
•	Strong fabrication, metalworking and problem-solving skills.
•	High attention to detail with a commitment to producing quality workmanship.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to plan and prioritise fabrication tasks effectively.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

SALARY: $79,499 to $82,992 PER ANNUM

Step Beyond the Workshop with BDGT - Technical Sales Engineer

Are you a trade qualified machinist or engineer ready to take your career in a new direction? If you enjoy solving technical problems and working with customers but still want to stay connected to the machining industry, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

For more than 50 years, BDGT has earned a reputation for precision, innovation, and engineering excellence. We partner with clients across the resources, packaging, construction, and manufacturing sectors to design and manufacture specialised components, machinery, and equipment.

Offering complete in house capability across machining, fabrication, assembly, refurbishment, and finishing, BDGT delivers end to end solutions and prides itself on quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.
The Opportunity:

As our Technical Sales Engineer, you'll draw on your engineering and machining background to provide practical solutions for customers and guide projects from concept through to completion. You will work closely with clients, suppliers, and our production teams, you'll become the link between customer requirements and successful project delivery.
Key Responsibilities:

    Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders
    Respond to technical enquiries and recommend fit for purpose solutions
    Review engineering drawings and specifications to prepare quotations and proposals
    Coordinate material requirements and supplier engagement
    Liaise with production teams to ensure projects remain on track
    Oversee project timelines and delivery milestones
    Provide technical guidance and support throughout the project lifecycle

What We're Looking For:

    Trade qualification in Engineering (Cert III) or a Mechanical Engineering qualification
    Experience working within machining, CNC, or manufacturing environments
    Sound understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering drawings
    Strong communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships
    A solutions focused approach and strong problem solving capability
    Good commercial acumen and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

Why Join BDGT?

Take the Next Step: Transition your engineering career into a technical and commercial role.

Interesting Projects: Work with customers across a range of industries on complex and rewarding projects.

Great Team Environment: Join an experienced and supportive team that values collaboration and initiative.

Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes   
  Brisbane | 12-Month Contract | Highly Attractive Daily Rates  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Project Engineer to join a leading global defence organisation supporting a significant land systems program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will play a key role in the delivery of complex capability projects from concept through to production and integration.   This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys balancing technical design responsibilities with project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and engineering governance. 
       
  Your new role  
   
 As a Senior Project Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of engineering activities across a complex defence program. You will work closely with design, systems, manufacturing and project management teams to ensure technical outcomes are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standards. 
   
 A key part of this role will involve the development and management of engineering designs and documentation using Creo or CAD and associated product lifecycle management tools.     Key Responsibilities  
   
 
 Coordinate engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Support project planning, scheduling and technical risk management. 
 Develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies and engineering documentation. 
 Create and maintain 3D CAD models and technical drawings using Creo or CAD. 
 Manage engineering change processes and design modifications. 
 Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Support design reviews, verification and validation activities. 
 Ensure compliance with defence, quality and engineering standards. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and production teams to support successful delivery outcomes. 
 
   
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience working as a Project Engineer within defence, aerospace, heavy vehicle, manufacturing or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong mechanical design experience. 
 Strong experience using PTC Creo or CAD for 3D modelling and design activities. 
 Experience producing and managing engineering drawings, BOMs and technical documentation. 
 Exposure to PLM systems such as Windchill would be highly regarded. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage competing priorities. 
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
   
 
 Long-term contract opportunity with strong likelihood of extension

 Opportunity to work on a nationally significant defence capability program. 
 Brisbane (Eagle Farm) location with a flexible and collaborative team environment. 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and cutting-edge defence technologies.
